Fixes after the quality audit of connecting. One parser of a public key as written anywhere (identity_key::parse_public_key: 0x or bare, any case) for the server list's targets, favorites, saved passwords (one with an upper-case key was never found), the ranked match record, broker keys and admin ids; files write it as identity_key::full_form. The key_ prefix in one place (identity_cert::is_key_account). ranked_match.json through an introspected struct; the kick reasons that refuse a rejoin shared by the server and the game instead of found by fragments of their text. Dead state out: server_auth_state's requires_authentication (sent, never read), client_identity_context::input, auth_requested, verified_has_no_ban with all_not_banned and the unreachable "Failed to check bans", server_adapter::get_public_key, the broker_keys_read flag, a dead IPv6 branch. server.key in one place (server_key::path, dedicated_start_error), the server's public key computed once, the secret key type and its derivation in augs (ed25519_secret_key), one protocol version rule (protocol_version.h) for the handshake and the server list, kick_now, steam_player_group_of, set_official in the masterserver, named limits and texts in client_setup. The key scheme ("Ed25519") named once and shown by --print-server-key, the favorites' note and the server key's tooltip. README_SERVER: no "c2-<key>", the account id in Settings - Account. Fork: docs say it has no connect tokens; one mismatch field, named graces.
